The smaller of the 2 Guinapac rocks stands just clear to S of the larger one, and the 3 Didicas rocks show separately and distinctly. Reference mark is 0.15 m. x 0.01 m. dia. brass rod set in concrete cement patty on top of a boulder flush with the surface and inscribed with the station name. PLGY is located on the roof-deck of Pangasinan Provincial Engineering Office, Capitol Complex, Brgy. Poblacion, Lingayen, Pangasinan. The antenna pillar is mounted on one of the building's column and approximately 15 m from the ground. It is readily accessible as there's an access ladder leading to the roof deck of the building. The station location is accessible to all types of Land vehicles as well as airplanes, it is just adjacent to Lingayen Airport. The Provincial Engineering Office is within the Pangasinan Provincial Capitol complex. This station is the second Active Geodetic Station established in Pangasinan next to PURD station in Urdaneta, Pangasinan. The station is equipped with velocity and displacement autonomous solution engine (VADASE) which detects fast movement in real time, and interference detection and mitigation feature for spectrum protection against different radio frequency interferences.
